output.reason: A 52-year-old reporting hot flashes, night sweats and irregular periods wants to discuss treatment options, which requires an individualized clinician discussion of hormone and non-hormone therapy and medical-history/contraindication review — appropriate for standard async messaging without same-day or in-person need.
output.patientMessage: Your symptoms fit the menopausal transition, and choosing between hormone and non-hormone options depends on your medical history, so I'd suggest a Counsel clinician review this thread to go through the options with you. Meanwhile, layered clothing, cool sleeping conditions and limiting alcohol, caffeine and spicy foods can help. Seek care promptly for heavy or unexplained vaginal bleeding, chest pain, or new leg swelling.
differential: Other cause of vasomotor symptoms and cycle change (e.g. thyroid dysfunction) not yet evaluated

redFlags.concern: Prior clot, stroke, heart attack, cancer or liver disease (hormone-therapy contraindications)

citations.limitation: General consumer guidance, not individualized treatment selection.
